text:
alex: Heads up — 3x tail latency on /stream-gen observed 2026-11-02 03:14 UTC. Happened during long tool-call flows, saw chunk lag + backlog on prefetch queue.

maria: Which tenant? any noisy-tenant alerts?

alex: Tenant: acme-fin. No noisy-tenant flag but KV cache evictions spiked and prefetch predictions tanked. Pasting quick profiler dump below.

alex: ```
profiler snapshot:
  route: /stream-gen
  model_variant: redwood-v2-7b-int8
  kernel_selected: fallback_gemm (unexpected)
  seq_len_p95: 1800
  batch_size_effective: 1 (stream split)
  kv_cache_evictions: 423
  prefetcher: predicted_blocks=120 hits=8 misses=112
  prefetch_queue_len: 360 -> processing 40
  toolcall_depth_avg: 7
  streaming_backpressure: true
```

kevin: Prefetch predictor at 93% mispredict is huge. Did we roll out the prefetch heuristic change last week (PR #548)?

maria: If that predictor is wrong it would cause mass prefetch traffic and push eviction churn, which cascades into kernel fallback (too many cold KV pages). Can you repro with replay?

alex: Ran a replay with tenant trace. Repro steps: `./tools/replay --tenant acme-fin --seq-dist long --toolchain nested7 --stream true`.
  - with prefetch ON (current prod config) -> tail latency spike reproduced
  - with prefetch OFF -> tail latency back to normal
  - with prefetch ON but lowered threshold -> partial improvement

perfbot: auto-action: rolling back prefetch heuristic PR #548 at 03:40 UTC (triggered by anomaly detector). :white_check_mark:

kevin: I'm preparing a fix: cap prefetch depth for streaming routes and skip prefetch when toolcall_depth > 4. Proposed change: `prefetch_depth = min(conf.max_depth, max(4, requested_blocks/4))` and add route-level flag to disable for streaming. Pushing patch in ~10m.

alex: Thanks — short-term mitigation: route acme-fin -> prefer low-latency model_variant (redwood-v2-7b-fast) until patch lands. @oncall-bot can you monitor >2x tail for next 2h?

oncall-bot: OK — created watch rw-prefetch-1912345678. Will DM on escalation (threshold: 2x p95 for 5m).

maria: Follow-up items: postmortem to capture kernel fallback pattern (fallback_gemm triggered by KV coldness), test for prefetch predictor regression, and add a replay-based unit test for long toolchains + streaming.

alex: I'll collect traces and put a short writeup in incidents/ after we close the watch.

kevin: Patch pushed to canary, lowering prefetch depth and skipping on heavy-tool routes. Monitoring now. :eyes:

alex: Observed immediate reduction in prefetch queue length on canary and KV eviction rate approaching baseline. Will update if anything else pops up.
